generator: tools/blender/of_render.py + of_pack.py (Blender 5.2 Cycles, bl_common camera / light, townfolk tf_* pipeline)

conventions.seatAnchor: seated anims: the seat point (0.45 m, seat front-centre)

notes: Officefolk fragment (CONTRACT_V42 AJ): 14 office anims (desk work, filing, the board, stamping, bowing, notes, handing over, the coin courier scooping and carrying his sack), 11 new parts and 8 presets.  Atlas JSONs are tfatlas v1 like assets/townfolk.  Block "officefolk" merges after assets/townfolk (townfolk2 / beachfolk / cityfolk optional) - see officefolk.merge.

ofPages.notes: One atlas per page.  "sack" (ofPages.resident) stays resident wherever officefolk staff can be seen, the plaza included: carry_sack, the aide's note (roam: her wardrobe + the adult limbs + the notebook), and the roaming extended layers in idle / walk / talk / wave / happy (bell pin, aide bow, teller bow tie, manager tie).  The clerk's cuff sleeves and the manager's blazer in those anims are on "desk" (office wear): off that page they are simply not drawn (pickAnim keeps the anim).  Load desk / work / errand with the office / bank / depot and drop them afterwards.  Ask pageNeeded(person, anim) (per person) inside the sprite's has() predicate.

counter.rule: liftPx = counterTopPx + 1 + impactPoint.stamp_stand[dir][1] (impact y is negative): the teller is drawn liftPx higher (DollSprite.lift, depth unchanged), standing on the counter step; the counter hides the legs.  Keep the lift for every anim played behind that counter.

bank.notes: civic bank tellers (staffPoints[0..2], SW = mirrored SE): lift by liftPx[base].SE.  The glass partitions of bank_front (up to glassTopPx) still veil the faces a little: civic-side (lighter glass or a separate glass layer), see the officefolk build report.

seat.anchor: seat front-centre at seat height (the townfolk2 sit convention, office deskPoints)
seat.notes: Put the sprite anchor ON the seat point.  The desk (the building's _interior_front) is drawn over the sitter and hides the legs; the legs are drawn whole anyway.  bases[b].deskSeat.groundOffsetPx = the floor under the sitter (soft shadow there), deskTopPx = the desk top line (bases[b].seat is townfolk2's sit, left alone).

office.notes: the deskPoint IS the seat front-centre: anchor on it.

bank.notes: The 은행장 sits at his desk behind staffPoints[3] (a FLOOR point): anchor at y - deskSeat.groundOffsetPx (about 25 px up) so he sits on his chair and the bank desk covers his lap; shadow on the point itself.  civic bank.deskPoint is a customer floor spot facing NW (seated anims have no NW): not a seat.

items.desk_write: held_pen on frames 0-3, held_stamp on 4-5 (impactFrame 4 = the stamp hits the paper; bases[b].impactPoint.desk_write[dir] = the contact point for a puff / sfx_stamp).
items.hand_over: no item is drawn: fly the real item (item_coin_sack_*, item_letter_bundle ...) from bases[b].handPoint[dir][i] (px from the anchor; mirrored dirs negate x), e.g. on frame 3.
items.scoop: held_sack_open; coins hop into bases[b].sackPoint.scoop[dir][i] (the open sack mouth between the mittens; of_check: within 3 px of the sack on every frame).
items.carry_sack: held_sack_shoulder (bounces with the walk, hangs outboard of the right shoulder with a coin emblem toward the camera in S / SE / E); sackPoint.carry_sack[dir][i] = the visible sack belly (coins hop in there too).  Move at bases[b].groundSpeed.carry_sack[dir] px/s, or play at timeScale = clamp(speed / groundSpeed, 0.8, 1.8) (TownSim style) so the feet do not skate.  One sack size: show the round's value with the coin hops / jingle (and item_coin_sack_s/m/l flown at the counter).  Without officefolk the game head-carries item_coin_sack_s/m/l on walk.
items.point_board: held_pointer; tipPoint.point_board[dir][i] = the pointer tip (the chalkboard bar it taps).
items.others: held_receiver (desk_phone), held_letter (desk_read sheet / file envelope), held_coins (desk_count), held_notebook (note) are drawn automatically (animItems); noItems skips them.

merge: Merge order: assets/townfolk "townfolk" <- (assets/townfolk2) <- (assets/beachfolk) <- (assets/cityfolk) <- assets/officefolk "officefolk".  The fragment REQUIRES only townfolk: it merges whether or not townfolk2 / beachfolk / cityfolk are loaded (v4.2 loads townfolk + officefolk).  tools/officefolk_compose.js mergeOfficefolk(man, ...fragments, manOffice) = cityfolk_compose.mergeTownfolkFragments + the two officefolk post rules below.

Generic merge (cityfolk.merge): atlases concatenate; anims, timeline, headPoses, parts, z, tintRef, palettes, frameAtlas add NEW keys only (a redefinition is an error); frameAtlasExt routes the officefolk frames of layers an earlier fragment owns: frameAtlasAnim[anim][layer@base]; bases[b]: headOffset gets the new anims, parts = union, other keys (ofCover, ofExt, handPoint, impactPoint, sackPoint, tipPoint, deskSeat) are added and groundSpeed gets the new key carry_sack (cityfolk's run / flee ... stay); tintTable[slot] union; generator.presets add; other top-level keys (animItems, animFallback, officefolkAnims, ofParts, ofPages, headPoseFallback ...) copied / shallow-merged.

Post rule 1 (headPoseFallback): when the merged block has no head pose "down" (townfolk2 not merged), every officefolk timeline frame with hp "down" uses "nod" instead (7 deg instead of 15 deg; every face used on those frames - neutral / blink / smile - exists on "nod").

Post rule 2 (preset force): generating an officefolk preset with a "force" list appends those parts after the normal generation when the person lacks them (no rng drawn).  The bank manager forces top_blazer: townfolk gives the blazer the ages child / adult only, and this fragment renders it for elders (bases[elder_*].parts); no other preset changes, so loading officefolk never changes anybody else's look.

canPlay(person, anim) = the cityfolk rule plus: officefolk anims need every worn body part (anim items excepted) in bases[b].ofCover[anim] (parts with an "anims" list: partPlays); in any other anim a part listed in bases[b].ofExt (a townfolk part this fragment rendered for a base townfolk did not pack it for: det_bow on adults, top_blazer / det_tie on elders) plays only its listed anims.  pickAnim walks animFallback (e.g. desk_write -> sit_idle -> sit -> idle, carry_sack -> walk + the game head-carries item_coin_sack_*).

Acting anims (all but carry_sack): the arms, mittens, cuff sleeves and items are drawn ABOVE the garments and the head stack in the front views (timeline zfront lists all four limbs in S / SE / E) - their frames are already cut wherever the body or the head hides them.  Nothing to do in the game: zfront is the townfolk rule.

Pages (ofPages): every officefolk atlas is one page; load the pages a scene needs (ofPages.scenes) and pass pickAnim a {has} predicate (pageNeeded(person, anim) resident).  sack (ofPages.resident) is small and resident wherever officefolk staff can be seen (the plaza included).  pageNeeded is per person: the anim's frames this person draws may sit on a page other than the anim's own (ofPages.roam: the aide's note on sack); with two pages it names the non-resident one.  pickAnim(person, anim, {has}): a townfolk anim whose only missing page holds the person's officefolk extended layers is played without them (no fallback).

Game runtime (src/core/Townfolk.js TF, DollSprite): call officefolk_compose.installOfficefolkRuntime(TF) once after TF.init(merged manifest).  It replaces TF.layersInto with layersIntoOF (frameAtlasAnim / frameAtlasPose, animItems, onlyAnims / noAnims / part anims, cfDrop, hidden head parts, zfrontFollow, face override, noItems) and wraps TF.person with the preset force rule; TF.of = Officefolk on the same block (pickAnim, points, pages).
officefolk.notes: Partial townfolk block (CONTRACT_V42 AJ): the office staff.  Merge after townfolk (+ townfolk2 / beachfolk / cityfolk when present) with tools/officefolk_compose.js mergeOfficefolk() (rules in "merge"), then compose exactly like tools/officefolk_compose.py.
